name: repo-decisions
description: Automatically inject and manage repository Architecture Decision Records for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Keep accepted Architecture Decision Records visible to Codex.
interface.longDescription: Repo ADR Decisions reads repository Architecture Decision Record markdown files, injects active accepted decisions through a UserPromptSubmit hook, exposes adr_* tools to locate/list/brief/add/supersede decisions, and keeps a wrapper fallback for deterministic Codex prompt enrichment.
defaultPrompt: Show active ADR decisions for this repo.
Add an ADR for this decision.
